name: @sos-2/web
description: SOS 2.0 Production Web Console (Work Order P1): the ShareNet-inspired product shell — desktop left navigation rail with a persistent status strip, mobile compact header + bottom navigation, the dominant mission/system/shortfall/next-action hero, the below-hero cards (current change, evidence quality, experiment status, package reuse, recent learning), the active autonomous work surface (tasks, body leases, observation status with SOS-is-watching shown separately from body work), first-class loading/empty/unknown/unavailable/partial/error state blocks, rationale deep-links answering the six product review questions, and full keyboard/accessibility support. Fully server-rendered from the @sos-2/web-contracts view models over the clearly-labelled DEMO fixture dataset — no client fetches, no remote fonts, no images, no hidden clocks.
